title: Leonida Trophy Guide — Grand Theft Auto VI (PS5)

trophies.guide: There is no separate task behind this one: it pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. Work the roadmap in order — story, then strangers and collectibles, then the long grinds — and use the tracker's progress bar to see what is still missing. Launch coverage puts the full hunt at roughly 100–200 hours, with the 100% completion trophy usually the last gate before this one.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end — the game's first mission, so it is unmissable and unlocks early. Being a story trophy, it stays hidden in your PlayStation list until it pops. No preparation helps here; just follow the opening as the game directs it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: See Chapter 1 through to its final mission. Chapter trophies fire automatically when the chapter's last mission ends, so keep pushing the story forward. Before the chapter closes, clear anything that only exists in Chapter 1 — most importantly Lucia's balcony meditation spot, which feeds the Positive Mental Attitude trophy and is reported to vanish after this chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. From here both protagonists are playable and most of the free-roam list opens up, so once the chapter trophy pops, start on the side activities and collectibles that need Jason and Lucia together. Save manually at the chapter's start: with no mission replay, a chapter-start save is the only way back.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 3 to its conclusion. The robbery trophies start unlocking from this chapter onward, so when the chapter ends, look at the robbery set — armored trucks, bank vaults and illegal operations — before moving on. Like every chapter, save manually at its start, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4, the final full chapter before the finale. By now the robbery and gang-operation trophies should be well underway; wrap up any chapter-gated side content before the final mission, and make a manual save before the finale — launch coverage reports no way to replay it.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Beat the final story mission. This is the campaign's gold trophy and the last chapter trophy: it unlocks as the finale's credits roll. Make a manual save before you begin the finale — it is your only route back to any final-mission moment, since the game has no mission replay — and finish any story-gated trophies you still want first.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies like this one unlock when the mission ends, so they cannot be missed as long as you finish the mission — but with no mission replay, a failed or abandoned run still has to be completed in that same playthrough. Follow the objectives the game gives you in the mission.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in GTA games usually offer a choice of approach — either way, the trophy is for completing the mission, not for the approach you choose. Get it done and the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies it unlocks the moment the mission completes. If a mission goes wrong midway, retry from the checkpoint rather than abandoning it — without mission replay, the cleanest path is to finish it in the same session.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. It is one of the named-mission trophies, so it pops when the mission ends. Play it through to completion in your story run; there is no separate requirement beyond finishing the mission itself.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at Vice City International Airport. The trophy is for mission completion alone. The airport also matters for the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can, so while you are at VCIA, keep that one in mind — but the two are separate unlocks.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Beat the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Like the other named-mission trophies, the only requirement is finishing it. Expect this one in the back half of the campaign — it is one of the later story unlocks.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Hit 100% on the game's in-game completion checklist — the gold trophy and, for most hunters, the last one before the platinum. The checklist is a fixed set of tasks (story, strangers, activities, collectibles); it does not mean doing literally everything in Leonida. Follow the in-game checklist itself, and use this guide's roadmap: the 100% tasks are exactly the story, stranger, activity and collectible trophies in this list. Launch coverage stresses that finishing the story alone is not 100% — the side content counts too.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Rack up 250 stunts around Leonida — jumps, near-misses and whatever else the game's stunt counter recognises. Treat it as a grind, not a skill test: most of it will happen on its own while you drive everywhere, then mop up the rest on a favourite route, such as the same jump ramp run again and again. Check the in-game stats or checklist for your running total before you start farming, so you do not overshoot.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type once — races, the shooting range, fishing, the arcade, drone races and the rest. This is the tourist trophy, there to make you sample everything. If you are not sure what counts, go down the activity trophies in this guide one by one; every first try also banks progress toward that trophy's own goal.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Gold is a score bar, so study how each challenge scores (accuracy and time are usually what matter), start with the weapon class you shoot best with, and repeat a challenge until the gold line clears. It is one of the six silvers and one of the tougher ones — leave it for the cleanup phase, once your aim and weapon handling are practised.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Take a win in a Top Fun drone race at every one of its locations across Leonida. The trophy wants a win in each place, not a single win. Learn a course's line before you race it for real, and remember a win at one location stands even if you lose somewhere else first — work through them location by location until the set is done.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same one 20 times. The game's races cover several types, so mix them up: street, off-road, water and air wherever the game offers them. Every first win also moves the race progress in the 100% checklist, so this slots neatly into the rest of the cleanup.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. These are head-to-head contests, so bring your best rod and bait and pay attention to the timing minigame instead of mashing through it. A single named-rival win is all it takes, and you can retry the challenge if the first attempt goes wrong.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play one arcade game all the way to its end screen. Arcades are scattered around Leonida; pick a short cabinet game, learn its one mechanic, and finish it. Any completed arcade game counts, so choose the easiest one you find rather than the flashiest.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: See Andy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger strands are chains of side missions for one character: follow Andy's chain from its first meeting to its last job and the trophy pops at the final mission's end. Stranger missions are part of the 100% checklist, so finishing Andy also moves A Long Road forward.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: See Kenton's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Like Andy's strand, this is a chain: meet Kenton, work through each of his jobs in order, and the trophy unlocks when his final mission completes.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: See Billy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Work the chain in order — each job unlocks the next — and the trophy pops at the end of his last mission.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight complete stranger mission strands across Leonida. This list names six strangers — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret — so find at least two more stranger chains in free roam to hit eight. A strand is a chain of missions for one character, so count finished chains, not single missions. Stranger strands also count toward the 100% checklist.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: See Randy's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Follow his chain from the first meeting through to the last job; the trophy unlocks when that final mission ends.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: See Tyrone's stranger mission strand through to its final mission. Work through his jobs in order and the trophy pops at the end of his last one.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at each meditation spot in Leonida. This is the one trophy launch coverage calls possibly missable: Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1 is reported to disappear once that chapter ends, and there is no mission replay — so meditate at the balcony during Chapter 1, before the chapter closes, and keep a manual save from the chapter's start as insurance. Clear the other spots in free roam once the story has opened the map. If a spot will not fire, stand right on its marker and wait for the prompt instead of mashing the button.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt down a unique animal for Bret as part of his stranger strand. Unique-animal hunts are one-off targets: follow Bret's instructions to the animal's area, track it, and take it down cleanly. The trophy is for the hunt itself, so do not expect the animal to respawn — make the shot count and save before the hunt in case it goes wrong.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete three full collectible card sets. Cards are tucked away around Leonida, and a set only counts when you hold every card in it — so treat this as a collection hunt with a map and a checklist. This guide's tracker can hold your per-set progress, but the in-game collection screen is the authority on which cards you still lack. Chase the sets you are nearest to finishing first, then sweep the remaining regions.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 separate locations. The counter is per location, so never revisit a spot — spread out over Leonida and let each new area add to the total. Run it together with the exploration trophy (The Goodtime State) and the vehicle-discovery trophy (Whip It Good): a single road trip can push all three forward at once.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Clear 50 challenges — the game's assorted side challenges, from stunts to shooting to minigames. Challenges are the small goals layered over free roam; do the easy ones first (driving, racing and shooting challenges you already practise for other trophies) and save the fiddly ones for the cleanup phase. Your in-game challenge list shows what is done and what is left.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: While your partner is with you, build up a 4-star wanted level, then shake it off and get away. The partner is the tricky part: do it during a mission or activity where your partner is present, not solo. Reach 4 stars fast by causing chaos somewhere busy; to lose it, break line of sight, leave the search area and stay hidden until the stars clear. If your partner walks off or the mission ends first, try again — the escape has to happen while you are partnered.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops back to back without ever dropping your wanted level — the streak matters, not the takings. Map a route through three shops close together, keep moving between them, and keep the heat up: losing the wanted level (or your partner) breaks the chain and you start again. A fast vehicle and a quiet route between shops count for more than speed inside them.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Find 100 different vehicles across Leonida. 'Discover' means finding a vehicle type you have not seen before, so variety beats repetition: drive, fly and sail everything you meet, and check new districts rather than circling the same streets. This pairs with The Goodtime State (explore all of Leonida) and You WAiNKer! (100 locations) — one long road trip advances all three.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In a single Combat Focus activation, take down five enemies. Set it up on purpose rather than hoping it happens: choose a fight with a group of five or more, wait until they bunch up, then trigger Combat Focus and work through them before it runs out. Ammo and cover count — begin with a full magazine and a spot the group has to come to you through.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport on terms the airport never scheduled — in practice, steal a plane and lift off without following the airport's script. The joke is in the wording: an 'unscheduled departure' is a getaway, so reach a runway aircraft, get airborne, and get clear of the airport. Expect a wanted level; that is part of the fun, not a failure.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Pull off something worth remembering in a Rhino tank — the description is a joke, and when the game launched no source had published a confirmed method for this trophy. The likely reading is mayhem in a Rhino: take one on a rampage and watch for the pop. Call this unconfirmed for now — check the cited list pages for a verified method as launch coverage grows, and do not trust a method that no second source repeats.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store with nobody detecting you. Stealth is what counts, not speed: case the store first, slip in quietly, stay out of the cameras and the guards' sightlines, and leave before the alarm state changes. If you are spotted, the attempt is over — back out, let the heat die down, and try again instead of fighting through it.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big jobs: each one wants a plan, a getaway vehicle and a clean exit. Do them one at a time and get fully clear before starting the next — the counter counts completed escapes, not vaults opened. This is one of the six silvers, so expect it to take the back half of the game.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away. Armored trucks patrol the roads: hit one when it stops, or force it to stop, take the cash, and get clear before the response shows up. The escape is part of the trophy — the pop comes after you break away, not at the robbery itself.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Cover every region of Leonida until the map is fully revealed. Exploration is a trophy of its own here, so drive the whole state: Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the rural north. The map screen shows what you have uncovered — work the blank patches systematically instead of wandering, and run the trip together with vehicle discovery (Whip It Good) and WAiNK locations (You WAiNKer!).
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each gang in Leonida. Every gang holds its own operations, so this is a set-completion trophy: find each gang's turf, hit its operation, and tick the set off one gang at a time. It fits with the other robbery trophies — vaults, trucks and shops — so plan your crime spree as one route rather than separate trips.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail somewhere overlooking Ocean Beach. This is a mood trophy, not a mission: find a bar or viewpoint on Ocean Beach, order the drink, and enjoy the view. When the game launched, no source had published a confirmed exact spot for this one, so treat the location as unconfirmed and check the cited list pages for a verified spot as launch coverage fills in.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle out through a showroom's frontage, in classic GTA style — straight through the glass. Choose a showroom, get a fast car inside or lined up outside, and go through the window instead of the door. When the game launched, no source had published a confirmed exact showroom for this one, so check the cited list pages for a verified location as launch coverage fills in.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — the trophy's wording points at the bowling follow-through itself. Head to that alley, play a game, and complete the follow-through motion on your throw. If the trophy does not pop on the first game, finish the game properly instead of quitting early.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build a partnership that the public notices — the description is deliberately vague, and when the game launched no source had published a confirmed method for this one. The sensible reading is a partner-activity goal: spend time on joint activities with your partner until the game recognises the partnership. Treat the method as unconfirmed and check the cited list pages for a verified route as launch coverage fills in.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: This trophy is about a decision point in the campaign. The description stays vague on purpose — it is a spoiler. Play through the story, and when a real choice is put in front of you, choose one and keep going; the trophy fires on the choice itself. With no mission replay, save manually before any big story decision so the other branch stays available to you later.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt at something that beat you the first time. The wording points at a retry trophy: fail a task, then come back and clear it. If it does not pop, think of the game's repeatable challenges — a second clean run after a failed first is the natural reading. When the game launched, no source had published a confirmed exact trigger, so treat the trigger as unconfirmed and check the cited pages for a verified method.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Trigger one of the game's stranger moments — the description is a joke about a surprise event, and when the game launched no source had published a confirmed exact trigger for this one. The natural reading is a rare random or scripted oddity in free roam: keep playing, explore unusual places, and the moment will find you. Treat the method as unconfirmed and check the cited list pages for a verified trigger as launch coverage fills in.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a drive-by with a melee weapon instead of a gun. Get a vehicle moving at speed past a target on foot, swing as you pass, and connect. Choose a quiet stretch of road so you can line the pass up without traffic or police in the way; if the first pass misses, circle round and try again.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are dirty money from robberies: take them to your laundering contacts and convert them in batches. This is a money grind that runs alongside the robbery trophies — every vault, truck and shop job feeds the pile, so launder as you go instead of saving it all for the end.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the game's shops — clothes, weapons, vehicles, food, whatever you buy. The counter is cumulative across all shops, so normal play already moves it; check your spending total and, near the end, top it up with a big purchase you actually want (a vehicle or a property beats burning cash on throwaways). It pairs naturally with the garage sweep for Little Boxes, which also runs on in-game cash.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties across Leonida. This one runs on in-game cash: earn first, then buy the garages in a sweep once you can afford them. Check the property list for the ones you still lack, and keep the counters straight — laundered money (Dime on the Dollar) and shop spending (Treat Yo Self) are separate tallies, and garage purchases count here, not there.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Track down ten different vehicles, open the app, and register each one. Variety helps — the app likely wants distinct vehicles, so do not register the same model ten times. This runs alongside vehicle discovery (Whip It Good): every new vehicle you find is a candidate for the app.
trophies.name: On the Spot
